Hi Maria —

Thanks for the quick turnaround window. Attached is a customer-facing one-page summary (final) and a one-page DPA snapshot called out for subprocessors and cross-border transfers. Highlights for procurement:
- Retention: Hosted API retains request/response data for troubleshooting and quality monitoring for up to 30 days by default. Customers can change retention settings via the Console or request a no-persistence option during onboarding.
- Residency: Console includes a residency toggle that pins runtime and storage to a selected region for hosted footprints; telemetry required for platform health may be pseudonymized and routed internationally. For strict residency we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment.
- Subprocessors: Redwood uses subprocessors (cloud providers, telemetry/observability vendors). We maintain a subprocessor list and require flow-down DPA obligations. The attached CSV is our current internal list; we can provide a redacted published list for procurement.
- KMS: BYOK/CMK (customer-managed keys) are supported in Dedicated and Private; hosted customers use provider-managed KMS with HSM-backed encryption available under enterprise agreements.
